items.cue: Karim, the barista at your café, texts you. He says tu to you. The strike is over.

turns.speaker: server
turns.name: Karim
turns.text: Ouf, le métro marche demain !

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Super ! ___, la grève est finie.

choices: The metro is on strike tomorrow

why: « Malheureusement » means unfortunately, but the end of the strike is good news.
« Dommage » means what a shame, but the end of the strike is good news.

items.cue: Théo's group chat « Les copains ». Everyone says tu. It's late, after the strike.

turns.speaker: server
turns.name: Théo
turns.text: Robin, t'es enfin chez toi ?

drills.prompt: Say yes, phew, and see you tomorrow!
drills.model: Oui ! Ouf, à demain !

items.cue: Léa, your flatmate, says tu to you. Which French word means “fortunately”?

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Le bus est en retard, mais ___, Théo a une place dans son covoiturage.

why: « Malheureusement » means unfortunately.
« Dommage » means what a shame.
